meaning: One list of every strategy that holds or held paper money, with its verdict. status: ACTIVE (trades, counts in the headline) | UNDER_REVIEW (trades, counts, under a review) | RETIRED (takes no new trades; its record is kept as evidence and shown apart) | PARKED (switched off by Madhav) | EVIDENCE (a measuring book: never counted as holdings). verdict: wont_take_again | will_try_again | modify_rules. Madhav, Oct 13: a useless strategy is marked, not deleted; the headline counts only what still trades.

BOOK500.name: The $500 NDAX book
BOOK500.why: The account Stage 1 would use: core by the dial, the one measured edge, the D12 brakes. Started Oct 11 at NDAX's real prices.

T3.name: Trend portfolio (10 coins)
T3.why: Passed both periods; a trend book loses in a sideways chop (Oct 4-13: Bitcoin flat, alts down) and that cost is known and accepted.

T3_T30.name: 30-coin trend book
T3_T30.why: Conflicting: fails the survivorship test on the 30 (review #22). Keeps running on paper until that is settled.

H07.name: Short dip trade (H07)
H07.why: The one measured edge (review #26: tier A while the dial is closed) and the one book that won this period (8 closed, 8 won). Tier C stays evidence.

JARVIS.name: Ananta's own picks (the brain)
JARVIS.why: 17 closed, all stopped out in the Oct chop, no better than its random twin (4 of 14). The rules changed on Oct 11: dip buys exit by time with no stop (review #27), triggers follow the evidence (review #28), no-room buys are recorded (D7). Judged again after 20 closed trades under the new rules.

ZONE_TOUCH.name: Daily zone touch
ZONE_TOUCH.why: A plain touch of a zone is not a reason to buy: it lost with every exit tried on 8 years of data (review #27) and 56 of 56 closed paper trades lost (-$573). Zones stay as context for the brain; the traded book stops.

EXPLORER.name: 15-minute Explorer (E1-E8)
EXPLORER.why: No intraday setup has an edge after costs: reviews #1, #3 and #24, and 0 of 55 atlas contexts stable. 30 closed, 25 lost. It keeps scanning as the intraday eyes and keeps its paper book only as evidence (Q1 live-vs-replay); it no longer wakes the brain.

HOURLY.name: Hourly watch (Hunter, Squeeze)
HOURLY.why: Parked by Madhav (D6, Oct 11); neither Hunter nor Squeeze showed an edge.

READS.name: Madhav's setups M1-M3 (universe books)
READS.why: Measured forward per tier against random; no measured edge yet (reviews #5, #26). Evidence only: never holdings.

RANDOM.name: Random baselines
RANDOM.why: The yardstick every book is measured against. Never holdings.

MANUAL.name: Madhav's own trades
MANUAL.why: His own paper trades, stamped with his initials; not a strategy Ananta judges.
